description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries for the resource-first context gate (road-to-design-artifact-fidelity Phase 2). Should-trigger covers the four Phase-2 cases — redesign with code present, screenshot-only, no-assets/owned-UI, and an inaccessible referenced source — plus an improve-existing case; all require inventorying project context BEFORE styling rather than starting from aesthetic memory. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbours whose vocabulary overlaps (backend/API, non-UI, general design knowledge, a genuinely trivial one-line UI edit) that must NOT force a full audit.

queries.q: redesign our dashboard — the React components are in src/components, make it cleaner
here is a screenshot of our current app, recreate this screen for us
rebuild our landing page in the same style as the rest of the product
match our Figma file at this link and rebuild the settings page (you may not be able to open it)
improve the UI of our existing checkout flow
add a rate limiter to the /orders API endpoint
write the SQL migration that adds a status column to the orders table
what is the difference between CSS flexbox and grid?
fix the typo in the README heading
explain how our CI release pipeline is structured
